verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወሀብኩ፡ ልብየ፡ ወልብየ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ርእየት፡ ከመ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወለጠቢባን፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍቅረ፡ ወጽልአ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘየአምር፡ ሰብእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ወከንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ።
verses.translation: I saw that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: yea, there is no man that knows either love or hatred, though all are before their face.

translations.lxx: I saw that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: yea, there is no man that knows either love or hatred, though all are before their face.
translations.kjv: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
translations.ron: Cu adevărat toate acestea le-am pus la inimă şi inima mea le-a văzut: că cei drepţi şi cei înţelepţi împreună cu toate faptele lor sunt în mina lui Dumnezeu. Nici măcar iubirea, nici ura nu o cunoaşte omul; ci totul este deşertăciune înaintea oamenilor,
translations.grk: Ὡς οἱ δίκαιοι καὶ οἱ σοφοὶ καὶ αἱ ἐργασίαι αὐτῶν ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καί γε ἀγάπην καί γε μῖσος οὐκ ἔστιν εἰδὼς ὁ ἄνθρωπος· τὰ πάντα πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወአሐዱ፡ ድድቁ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ወለረሲዕ፡ ለኄር፡ ወለእኩይ፡ ለርኩስ፡ ወለንጹሕ፡ ለዘይሠውዕ፡ ወለዘኢይሠውዕ፡ ለኄር፡ ወለዘሂ፡ የኃጥእ፡ ለዘይምሕል፡ ወለዘሂ፡ ይፈርህ፡ መሐላ።
verses.translation: Vanity is in all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good, and to the bad; both to the pure, and to the impure; both to him that sacrifices, and to him that sacrifices not: as is the good, so is the sinner: as is the swearer, even so is he that fears an oath.

translations.lxx: Vanity is in all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good, and to the bad; both to the pure, and to the impure; both to him that sacrifices, and to him that sacrifices not: as is the good, so is the sinner: as is the swearer, even so is he that fears an oath.
translations.kjv: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
translations.ron: Căci toţi au aceeaşi soartă: cel drept ca şi cel păcătos, cel bun ca şi cel rău, cel curat ea şi cel necurat, cel ce aduce jertfă ca şi cel ce nu aduce, cel bun ca şi cel rău, cel ce jură ca şi cel ce cinsteşte jurământul.
translations.grk: Ματαιότης ἐν τοῖς πᾶσι· συνάντημα ἓν τῷ δικαίῳ καὶ τῷ ἀσεβεῖ, τῷ ἀγαθῷ καὶ τῷ κακῷ, καὶ τῷ καθαρῷ καὶ τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ, καὶ τῷ θυσιάζοντι καὶ τῷ μὴ θυσιάζοντι· ὡς ὁ ἀγαθὸς ὡς ὁ ἁμαρτάνων, ὡς ὁ ὀμνύων καθὼς ὁ τὸν ὅρκον φοβούμενος.

verses.geez: ዝክቱ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ እስመ፡ አሐዱ፡ ድድቁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ወልቦሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ትፌጽም፡ እኩየ፡ ወበሁከተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ሕይወቶሙ፡ ወእምድኅሬሆሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ምውታን።
verses.translation: There is this evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yea, the heart of the sons of men is filled with evil, and madness is in their heart during their life, and after that they go to the dead.

translations.lxx: There is this evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yea, the heart of the sons of men is filled with evil, and madness is in their heart during their life, and after that they go to the dead.
translations.kjv: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
translations.ron: Este un mare rău în tot ceea ce se face sub soare, căci toţi au aceeaşi soartă şi pe lângă aceasta inima oamenilor este plină de răutate şi nebunia în inima lor dăinuieşte toată viaţa lor şi se duc în acelaşi loc cu cei morţi;
translations.grk: Τοῦτο πονηρὸν ἐν παντὶ πεποιημένῳ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ὅτι συνάντημα ἓν τοῖς πᾶσι· καί γε καρδια υἱῶν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπληρώθη πονηροῦ, καὶ περιφέρεια ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐν ζωῇ αὐτῶν, καὶ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν πρὸς τοὺς νεκρούς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይሳተፍ፡ ምስለ፡ ሕያዋን፡ በተስፋ፡ ከልብ፡ ሕያው፡ ይኄይስ፡ እምአንበሳ፡ ምውት።
verses.translation: For who is he that has fellowship with all the living? there is hope of him: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

translations.lxx: For who is he that has fellowship with all the living? there is hope of him: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
translations.kjv: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
translations.ron: Oare cine va rămâne în viaţă? Pentru toţi cei vii este o nădejde, căci un câine viu este mai de preţ decât un câine mort.
translations.grk: Ὅτι τίς ὃς κοινωνεῖ πρὸς πάντας τοὺς ζῶντας; ἔστιν ἐλπὶς, ὅτι ὁ κύων ὁ ζῶν αὐτὸς ἀγαθὸς ὑπὲρ τὸν λέοντα τὸν νεκρόν·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሕያዋን፡ የአምሩ፡ ከመ፡ ይመውቱ፡ ወሙታንሰ፡ ኢየአምሩ፡ ወኢምንትኒ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ እንከ፡ ዓስብ።
verses.translation: For the living will know that they shall die: but the dead know nothing, and there is no longer any reward to them; for their memory is lost.

translations.lxx: For the living will know that they shall die: but the dead know nothing, and there is no longer any reward to them; for their memory is lost.
translations.kjv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
translations.ron: Cei vii ştiu că vor muri, dar cei morţi nu ştiu nimic şi parte de răsplată nu mai au, căci numele lor a fost uitat.
translations.grk: Ὅτι οἱ ζῶντες γνώσονται ὅτι ἀποθανοῦνται, καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ οὐκ εἰσὶ γινώσκοντες οὐδέν· καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς ἔτι μισθὸς, ὅτι ἐπελήσθη ἡ μνήμη αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: እስመዝክሮሙ፡ ወፍቅሮሙ፡ ወጽልኦሙኒ፡ ወቅንአቶሙኒ፡ ናሁ፡ ተኃጒለ፡ ወመክፈልት፡ አልቦሙ፡ እንከ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, have now perished; yea, there is no portion for them any more for ever in all that is done under the sun.

translations.lxx: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, have now perished; yea, there is no portion for them any more for ever in all that is done under the sun.
translations.kjv: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
translations.ron: Şi dragostea lor, ura lor şi pizma lor a pierit de mult şi nu se vor mai bucura niciodată de ceea ce se face sub soare.
translations.grk: Καί γε ἀγάπη αὐτῶν, καί γε μῖσος αὐτῶν, καί γε ζῆλος αὐτῶν ἤδη ἀπώλετο· καί γε μερὶς οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς ἔτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐν παντὶ τῷ πεποιημένῳ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: ነዓ፡ ብላዕ፡ በፍሥሓ፡ ኅብስተከ፡ ወስተይ፡ በልብ፡ ኄር፡ ወይነከ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሠምረ፡ ምግባሪከ።
verses.translation: Go, eat thy bread with mirth, and drink thy wine with a joyful heart; for now God has favourably accepted thy works.

translations.lxx: Go, eat thy bread with mirth, and drink thy wine with a joyful heart; for now God has favourably accepted thy works.
translations.kjv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
translations.ron: Du-te şi mănâncă cu bucurie pâinea ta şi bea cu inimă bună vinul tău, pentru că Dumnezeu este îndurător pentru faptele tale.
translations.grk: Δεῦρο φάγε ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ τὸν ἄρτον σου, καὶ πίε ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀγαθῇ οἶνόν σου, ὅτι ἤδη εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὰ ποιήματά σου.

verses.geez: በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ይኩን፡ ንጹሐ፡ አልባሲከ፡ ወቀቅብዕ፡ እምርእስከ፡ ኢይርኃቅ።
verses.translation: Let thy garments be always white; and let not oil be wanting on thine head.

translations.lxx: Let thy garments be always white; and let not oil be wanting on thine head.
translations.kjv: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
translations.ron: Toată vremea veşmintele tale să fie albe şi untdelemnul să nu lipsească de pe capul tău!
translations.grk: Ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἔστωσαν ἱμάτιά σου λευκὰ, καὶ ἔλαιον ἐπὶ κεφαλῆς σου μὴ ὑστερησάτω.

verses.geez: ወርኢ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ እንተ፡ አፍቀርካ፡ ኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትከ፡ እለ፡ ተውህባከ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እለ፡ ኮና፡ ለከ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ በሕይወትከ።
verses.translation: And see life with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which are given thee under the sun: for that is thy portion in thy life, and in thy labour wherein thou labourest under the sun.

translations.lxx: And see life with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which are given thee under the sun: for that is thy portion in thy life, and in thy labour wherein thou labourest under the sun.
translations.kjv: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
translations.ron: Bucură-te de viaţă cu femeia pe care o iubeşti în toate zilele vieţii tale celei deşarte, pe care ţi-a hărăzit-o Dumnezeu sub soare; căci aceasta este partea ta în viaţă şi în mijlocul trudei cu care te osteneşti sub soare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἴδε ζωὴν μετὰ γυναικὸς ἧς ἠγάπησας πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ζωῆς ματαιότητός σου, τὰς δοθείσας σοι ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ὅτι αὐτὸ μερίς σου ἐν τῇ ζωῇ σου, καὶ ἐν τῷ μόχθῳ σου ᾧ σὺ μοχθεῖς ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: ወበሥራኅከ፡ ዘትሠርኅ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘትክል፡ እዴከ፡ ለገቢር፡ መጠነ፡ ኃይልከ፡ ግበር፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ግብር፡ ወሕሊና፡ ወጥበብ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ውስተ፡ ገሃነም፡ ኀበ፡ ተሐውር፡ አንተ፡ ህየ።
verses.translation: Whatsoever thine hand shall find to do, do with all thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Hades whither thou goest.

translations.lxx: Whatsoever thine hand shall find to do, do with all thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Hades whither thou goest.
translations.kjv: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
translations.ron: Tot ceea ce mâna ta prinde să săvârşească, fă cu hotărâre, căci în locuinţa morţilor în care te vei duce nu se află nici faptă, nici punere la cale, nici ştiinţă, nici înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Πάντα ὅσα ἂν εὕρῃ ἡ χείρ σου τοῦ ποιῆσαι, ὡς ἡ δύναμίς σου ποίησον, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι ποίημα καὶ λογισμὸς καὶ γνῶσις καὶ σοφία ἐν ᾅδῃ, ὅπου σὺ πορεύῃ ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez: ወተመየጥኩ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ከመ፡ አኮ፡ ለቀሊላን፡ ረዊዕ፡ ወአኮ፡ ለጽኑዓን፡ ቀትል፡ ወአኮ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ እክል፡ ወአኮ፡ ለማእምራን፡ ብዕል፡ ወአኮ፡ ለእለ፡ ይሴብዉ፡ ጸጋ፡ እስመ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወድድቅ፡ ይዳደቆሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ።
verses.translation: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor yet bread to the wise, nor yet wealth to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of knowledge; for time and chance will happen to them all.

translations.lxx: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor yet bread to the wise, nor yet wealth to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of knowledge; for time and chance will happen to them all.
translations.kjv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
translations.ron: Şi iarăşi am văzut sub soare că izbânda în alergare nu este a celor iuţi şi biruinţa a celor viteji, şi pâinea a celor înţelepţi, nici bogăţia a celor pricepuţi, nici faima pentru cei învăţaţi, căci timpul şi întâmplarea întâmpină pe toţi.
translations.grk: Ἐπέστρεψα καὶ εἶδον ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ὅτι οὐ τοῖς κούφοις ὁ δρόμος, καὶ οὐ τοῖς δυνατοῖς ὁ πόλεμος, καί γε οὐ τῷ σοφῷ ἄρτος, καί γε οὐ τοῖς συνετοῖς πλοῦτος, καί γε οὐ τοῖς γινώσκουσι χάρις, ὅτι καιρὸς καὶ ἀπάντημα συνατήσεται σύμπασιν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢየአምር፡ ሰብእ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ከመ፡ ዓሣት፡ እለ፡ ይሠገሩ፡ በመርበብት፡ እኩይ፡ ወከመ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ዘይትአኀዙ፡ በመሥገርት፡ ከማሁ፡ ይሠገሩ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ በጊዜ፡ እኩይ፡ ሶበ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ግብተ።
verses.translation: For surely man also knows not his time: as fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as birds that are caught in a snare; even thus the sons of men are snared at an evil time, when it falls suddenly upon them.

translations.lxx: For surely man also knows not his time: as fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as birds that are caught in a snare; even thus the sons of men are snared at an evil time, when it falls suddenly upon them.
translations.kjv: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
translations.ron: Că omul nu ştie nici măcar vremea lui: întocmai ea şi peştii care sunt prinşi în vicleanul năvod, întocmai ca şi păsările în laţ, aşa sunt prinşi fără de veste oamenii în vremea de restrişte, când vine dintr-odată peste ei.
translations.grk: Ὅτι καί γε καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ ἄνθρωπος τὸν καιρὸν αὐτοῦ, ὡς οἱ ἰχθύες οἱ θηρευόμενοι ἐν ἀμφιβλήστρῳ κακῷ, καὶ ὡς ὄρνεα τὰ θηρευόμενα ἐν παγίδι· ὡς αὐτὰ παγιδεύονται οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς καιρὸν πονηρὸν, ὅταν ἐπιπέσῃ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἄφνω.

verses.geez: ወናሁ፡ ዘንተኒ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ጥበበ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: This I also saw to be wisdom under the sun, and it is great before me:

translations.lxx: This I also saw to be wisdom under the sun, and it is great before me:
translations.kjv: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
translations.ron: Şi am mai văzut sub soare acest fapt de înţelepciune care mi s-a părut într-adevăr mare:
translations.grk: Καί γε τοῦτο εἶδον σοφίαν ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, καὶ μεγάλη ἐστι πρὸς μέ·

verses.geez: ወዓባይ፡ ይእቲ፡ በኀቤየ፡ ሀገር፡ ነወስቲት፡ ወሰብእ፡ እለ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ኅዳጣን፡ ወአመ፡ መጽአ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወዓገታ፡ ወየሐንጽ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ጥቅመ፡ ዓቢየ።
verses.translation: suppose there were a little city, and few men in it; and there should come against it a great king, and surround it, and build great mounds against it;

translations.lxx: suppose there were a little city, and few men in it; and there should come against it a great king, and surround it, and build great mounds against it;
translations.kjv: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
translations.ron: A fost odată o cetate mică, locuită de oameni puţini şi împotriva ei a pornit un rege vestit, care a împresurat-o şi a ridicat de jur împrejur întărituri puternice.
translations.grk: Πόλις μικρὰ καὶ ἄνδρες ἐν αὐτῇ ὀλίγοι, καὶ ἔλθῃ ἐπʼ αὐτὴν βασιλεὺς μέγας καὶ κυκλώσῃ αὐτὴν, καὶ οἰκοδομήσῃ ἐπʼ αὐτὴν χάρακας μεγάλους·

verses.geez: ወረከበ፡ በውስቴታ፡ ብእሴ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ወነዳየ፡ ወያድኅን፡ ሀገረ፡ ውእቱ፡ በጥበቡ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተዘከሮ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ብእሲ።
verses.translation: and should find in it a poor wise man, and he should save the city through his wisdom: yet no man would remember that poor man.

translations.lxx: and should find in it a poor wise man, and he should save the city through his wisdom: yet no man would remember that poor man.
translations.kjv: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
translations.ron: Într-însa se afla un sărac înţelept care a scăpat cetatea prin înţelepciunea lui şi nimeni nu-şi mai aduce aminte de acest om sărman.
translations.grk: καὶ εὕρῃ ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρα πένητα σοφὸν, καὶ διασώσῃ αὐτὸς τὴν πόλιν ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἐμνήσθη σὺν τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τοῦ πένητος ἐκείνου.

verses.geez: ወእቤ፡ አነ፡ ትኄይስ፡ ጥበብ፡ እምኃይል፡ ወጥበቡ፡ ለነዳይ፡ እንተ፡ ትትሜነን፡ ወነገሮሂ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ እለ፡ ይሰምዕዎ።
verses.translation: And I said, Wisdom is better than power: yet the wisdom of the poor man is set at nought, and his words not listened to.

translations.lxx: And I said, Wisdom is better than power: yet the wisdom of the poor man is set at nought, and his words not listened to.
translations.kjv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
translations.ron: Şi am zis: "Mai bună este înţelepciunea decât puterea; dar înţelepciunea celui sărac este urgisită, şi cuvintele lui nu sunt luate în seamă".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπα ἐγὼ, ἀγαθὴ σοφία ὑπὲρ δύναμιν· καὶ σοφία τοῦ πένητος ἐξουδενωμένη, καὶ οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ οὐκ εἰσακουόμενοι.

verses.geez: ወለነገረ፡ ጠቢባን፡ በዕረፍት፡ ይሰምዕዎ፡ እምነ፡ ጽራሖሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይኴንኑ፡ በዕበድ።
verses.translation: The words of the wise are heard in quiet more than the cry of them that rule in folly.

translations.lxx: The words of the wise are heard in quiet more than the cry of them that rule in folly.
translations.kjv: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
translations.ron: Vorbele celui înţelept spuse domol sunt mai ascultate decât strigătul unui stăpân între nebuni.
translations.grk: Λόγοι σοφῶν ἐν ἀναπαύσει ἀκούονται ὑπὲρ κραυγὴν ἐξουσιάζόντων ἐν ἀφροσύναις.

verses.geez: ትኄይስ፡ ጥበብ፡ እምንዋየ፡ ሐቅል፡ ዘየኃጥእ፡ አሐደ፡ ያኃጒል፡ ብዙኀ።
verses.translation: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: and one sinner will destroy much good.

translations.lxx: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: and one sinner will destroy much good.
translations.kjv: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea este mai de preţ decât armele de luptă; dar o singură greşeală nimiceşte mult bine.
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὴ σοφία ὑπὲρ σκεύη πολέμου· καὶ ἁμαρτάνων εἷς ἀπολέσει ἀγαθωσύνην πολλήν.
